primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Percentage reduction in UPCR was obtained from geometric mean ratios. The natural log-transformed ratio of UPCR to its baseline value was analyzed using a Mixed Model for Repeated Measures (MMRM), adjusted by baseline variables specified in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP), including data from baseline up to Week 36 during the Double-Blind period.
